selection_rule: A page with at least 2 impressions at average position <= 15 in the 28-day Search Console window (gsc_search_analytics_export.json by_page); utility pages excluded.
finding: Search Console anonymises every query behind these three pages, so the title/H1 stay on the page's topic phrase. Each already carries a direct answer (data-direct-answer) and FAQPage JSON-LD from its source sections; what each lacked was a link from the homepage, which scripts/install_site_head_assets.js now adds at publish time (data-search-ranked-links) without touching the frozen accepted bytes.
